property_summary: For any caller who successfully calls lockInGuess sending exactly 1 ether, the reference contract always records a nonzero future block number for that caller (guesses[msg.sender].block != 0), whereas the mutant that omits setting the block leaves it zero and thus violates this property for those inputs.
change_summary: Remove the block assignment entirely so the stored block remains zero (no guesses[msg.sender].block set).
